facts.text: The hotel occupies the original Ottoman palace on the Bosphorus, which CNT describes as the only Ottoman palace overlooking the Bosphorus.
facts.excerpt: housed in and around the only Ottoman palace overlooking the Bosphorus

facts.text: Before becoming a hotel, the palace was a royal court, parliamentary meeting space and beauty pageant venue.
